coaching_note: Jules must ask the two-concerns question early in step 2 to uncover what matters to the customer, deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) in step 3, and ask for the business explicitly in step 7 with rate lock and no deposit framing before scheduling.
